A Framework for Performance-Based Earthquake Engineering of Abutment Systems
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the new graphical user interface provides a powerful tool for the analysis and design of bridge abutments.
the new interface provides a convenient and systematic tool for conducting parametric studies of bridge abutments and their underlying ground systems.
the proposed analysis framework is a useful tool to conduct parametric studies and to investigate the effect of various abutment and soil parameters on the performance of the overall bridge system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
PBEE can be successfully applied to the analysis of bridge ground systems.
the developed interface can be used as a tool to facilitate parametric studies of bridge systems under earthquake loading.
a performance based earthquake analysis of a bridge abutment system, using the PBEE framework and OpenSeesPL, is feasible and can be conducted in a systematic and computationally efficient manner.
